question: exact response bytes, route load runs and sync bytes of the v0.3 artifact for a held collection of 50, 500 and 5000 rows, after one row, ten rows, one percent of rows, one delete or one add, as a list of rows or as records; the same changes through the v0.4 dataset patch applied by the worker store (requests, bytes, rows written, row hashes); and whether the query proof verifies on the server and on the client after materialize; and for a plain HTTP resource of the same rows, the bytes a browser cache still sends: a first load, a revalidation with no change (a 304) and one after the change (a 200)
instrument: spool.respond on an in-process createSpool with a memory store, no browser; node:zlib gzip and brotli of each response body; load runs counted inside the route; the v0.4 arm runs the worker store (Replica over memoryStorage, syncDataset) with commits and row hashes counted; the native arm is a node:http server on 127.0.0.1 that counts its socket bytesWritten per response (status line, headers and body), requested with fetch

method.route: template strategy, query { list: "rows" }, depends ["dataset"], loads counted

shapes.list: the rows inline in the data; the proof is over the rows
shapes.records: each row registered with ctx.record; the list holds refs; the proof is over the resolved rows (the 2026-11-03 reading used a proof over the refs, which the client check refused)

changes.change-1, change-10, change-1pct: bump dataset, and the row tag of each changed row in the records shape; change-1pct is max(2, ceil(N / 100)) rows

method.refetch: each scenario runs on a fresh spool: seed, change, then one refetch with have and one without, both in the same state; then /.spool/sync from the seed vector
method.have: the seed record ids and versions, the first 256 when there are more; a full have above 256 is sent once as fullHave

gates.gate open: route provision { reuse: 1, futureViews: 1000 }, so benefit() is positive at every size here

method.proof: gate open arm: verifyProof on the built data, Graph.put and materialize from src/sw/graph, then verifyProof and shapeQuery on the materialized data
method.v04: kind v04 rows: a dataset "rows" on a backend that keeps its digest; the device seeds with syncDataset, one change is made, then one more sync; seed and patch bytes are the sum of the responses of that phase; puts, deletes and commits are what the store wrote; rowHashes counts row hashes the device computed
method.dataProbe: a data route with default priors, one row, to check the gate on that strategy
method.titles: 40 to 80 ASCII characters from a seeded generator
method.native: kind native rows: the collection as one JSON resource with an ETag and Cache-Control max-age=0, brotli when accepted; three fetches per row: no validator (the first load, 200), If-None-Match before any change (304), and If-None-Match after the change (200); socketBytes is the server socket bytesWritten delta across the response, bodyBytes the uncompressed JSON, wireBytes the body as sent
method.load: 1, 5 and 15 minute load averages 9.24, 6.48, 5.61 on 12 CPUs at start
method.bytes: raw response body; a 204 is a declined artifact and counts 0 bytes

exclusions: none; a row with status 204 is a declined artifact with 0 bytes, kept as measured
